summary: Added a shipped git fixture helper (tests/support/git-fixture.ts) and test (tests/git-fixture.test.ts) to generated repositories and disabled automatic git maintenance (maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0) in both the shipped helper and the template's tests/support/git-fixture.ts so fixture commits do not start background git maintenance.
action: Nothing to do by hand: tests/support/git-fixture.ts and tests/git-fixture.test.ts carry the template owner label, so Template upgrade takes both files whole; a repository's own git tests can switch to gitFixture and git.
